levels.surface: أحمد بن محمد بن يحيى العطار
عبيد الله بن عبد الله الدهقان

notes: «سمعت الصادق جعفر بن محمد يحدث» names the Imam in the words after the chain: imam_in_text (owner ruling 2).

The Imam then goes on «عن أبيه، عن آبائه» to the Prophet; these kin-links are kept as relations, and the Prophet is not a link. This continues past the Imam, so the ruling's «last item» reading is not applied here.
«عروة بن أخي شعيب» is one name (nephew of Shu'ayb), not a relation (rule 7).
